quests.name: Onu is Meditating
quests.summary: I am meditating on your task, <name>.  Meditating on reasons why the Twilight's Hammer and naga are here.When you are ready, use the phial of scrying to create a scrying bowl.  Then, contact me through the bowl.If you have lost your phial of scrying, then here is another.

quests.name: Onu is Meditating
quests.summary: The finding of Twilight's Hammer cultists is troubling.  I must meditate on their intentions...When you have more information, speak to me through a scrying bowl.  If you require a phial of scrying in order to create a bowl, then...here is another.
